scripts.build: pnpm --recursive --if-present run build && pnpm run build:go
scripts.build:go: go -C gen/proto build ./... && go -C packages/verification-go build ./... && go -C packages/cli-go build ./...
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint:contracts && pnpm run generate:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:java && pnpm run security:check
scripts.generate:check: pnpm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- gen/proto packages/runner-protocol/src/gen packages/api-client/src/gen openapi/execution-evidence-v1.json openapi/execution-evidence-v2.json
scripts.lint:contracts: buf lint proto/provenance/runner/v1 && pnpm run lint:openapi
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:go-verifier && pnpm run test:cli && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test && pnpm run test:python && pnpm run test:vectors && pnpm run test:openapi && pnpm run test:proto && pnpm run test:release && pnpm run test:paper-harness
scripts.test:cli: test -z "$(gofmt -l packages/cli-go)" && go -C packages/cli-go test -race ./... && go -C packages/cli-go vet ./... && go -C packages/cli-go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.7.0 ./...
scripts.security:check: pnpm audit --audit-level high --ignore-registry-errors && go -C gen/proto run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.7.0 ./... && go -C packages/verification-go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.7.0 ./...
scripts.test:python: python schemas/config/test_contract.py && python schemas/attestation/test_contract.py && python schemas/paper-metadata/test_contract.py && python schemas/key-discovery/test_contract.py
scripts.test:go-verifier: test -z "$(gofmt -l packages/verification-go/*.go)" && go -C packages/verification-go test -race ./... && go -C packages/verification-go vet ./...
